title: Viral Stuffed Medjool Date Snickers (Zero Refined Sugar)
hookLine: Chewy caramel Medjool dates stuffed with creamy peanut butter, crunchy roasted peanuts & dark chocolate shell.

items.name: Melted 85% dark chocolate + 1 tsp coconut oil

steps.title: Line Freezer Tray & Prep Mix-Ins
steps.instructionTemplate: Line a rimmed baking sheet or loaf pan with parchment paper so your frozen treat lifts out cleanly. Measure out {hd_dates} and {hd_pb} and keep toppings like {hd_nuts} and {hd_choc} prepped within reach.

steps.title: Slice Dates & Spoon Peanut Butter
steps.instructionTemplate: Split {hd_dates} lengthwise, fill each cavity with {hd_pb}, and press {hd_nuts} right into the center. Line your chilling pan or tray with parchment paper for easy lifting, and keep {hd_dates}, {hd_pb}, and {hd_nuts} measured and ready to combine.
steps.creatorSecret: Freeze the stuffed dates for 10 mins before dipping so the chocolate shell snaps crisp instantly.

steps.title: Transfer, Smooth Top & Add Garnish
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour or press the mixture evenly into your prepared dish, smoothing the surface with a spatula. Scatter {hd_nuts} and {hd_choc} evenly across the top and press gently so it adheres cleanly.

steps.title: Dip in 85% Dark Chocolate & Freeze
steps.instructionTemplate: Dip each stuffed date in {hd_choc}, top with flaky sea salt, and chill 15 minutes until snappy. Gently press the coating onto every side so it adheres evenly, then let excess drip off before transferring to a clean tray.

ugcQuotes.quote: Zero refined sugar and only 165 cal—tastes like total indulgence!
